title: Court Slashes Award Alex Jones Was Ordered to Pay Sandy Hook Parents
summary: An appeals court reduced the award to the parents of one victim to $6 million from $49 million, citing a Texas damages cap. The conspiracy theorist owes over $1 billion in other cases.
